opportunities.title: Small grants

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. Travel/subsistence awards up to £2,000 per person for trips up to 13 days, up to £2,500 per person for 14 days or more.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution willing to receive grant funds. Applications not accepted from individuals for personal projects, though the UK office may consider individuals with organisational backing. UK projects submitted to the UK office, Japan projects to the Japan office.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding enabling UK-Japan projects that bring people in the UK and Japan together to deepen mutual understanding, exchange ideas/expertise, or develop lasting collaboration. Supports festivals/workshops/performances, exchanges, collaborative projects, Japanese language and cultural studies, and academic research/visits. UK office holds three annual awards meetings (deadlines 31 March, 15 September, 15 December); Japan office holds two (28 February, 30 September).

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

amount.raw: Butterfield Awards of up to £10,000 in medicine and health. Continuing projects lasting up to three years to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Health and medical professionals, researchers, practitioners, policy makers, managers and voluntary sector workers in the UK and Japan. Project must involve partners in both the UK and Japan. Preference given to those who have not previously been involved in UK-Japan collaboration and early-career applicants. Applicants should normally show an existing research record.
opportunities.summary: Annual awards supporting exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, including study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. Annual deadline is 1 December for a decision in March of the following year. Grants may be used for travel expenses and other costs including conference and publication costs.
